messages.subject: בעיה charset בShiny
parts:
I have got a small charset problem

i can run the shinyapp i made in the shiny servers that are unix based without a problem. https://yonicd.shinyapps.io/Elections

but when i run the code using

shiny::runGitHub("Elections","yonicd")

it wont run unless the locale is set

Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "Hebrew_Israel.1255")

making the (windows) user run

#If running on Windows Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "Hebrew_Israel.1255")
shiny::runGitHub("Elections","yonicd")
Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL")

which is annoying at best.

the raw code is in github (global.r) if anyone can figure it out then it would be great. ive tried many things but nothing really helps...

thanks
yoni
